duration.text: The Management of Farming and Forestry at Southwest University is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/In total ￥ 15000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3.High school academic transcript 4.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test),No need for English medium programs

requirements.text: 1.The applicants should have had senior high school education and enjoy good health. 2.If the applicants' Chinese HSK level can not reach the requirement of Southwest University, they can first take the Chinese language study program for Chinese study.
